media.caption: Painted cotton, fourth–third centuries BCE, with imagery related to Chavín. The reported origin does not reveal a complete route. Four numbered modern annotations point to surviving details; the underlying photograph is unchanged and no missing design has been restored.
notice: How might a cloth travel differently from a carved wall?
media.creator: Chavín artist(s)
media.place: Peru; said to come from the southern coast
media.relevance: Revised chronology, portable imagery and uncertain provenance.
